x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: NORAD — tooling suite for Burgr projects

commands.name: init-repo
commands.description: Initialize an empty Burgr project structure.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project name (e.g. Mpc). Defaults to the target folder name.

options.name: --module
options.description: Optional initial bounded-context module (e.g. Recipes). Scaffolds dotnet layer folders and a models/<Module> tree.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files if they already exist.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Target directory (defaults to the current directory).
